scope: Chapter 13 «A1+» of the Moin scene prototype: the club exam in four parts, the station announcement and phone message, the lost truck driver, the newcomer Luca and the Küstenlogbuch; 49 voice lines and 6 story expressions
notes: Each phrase has three takes; the chosen take has the closest transcript, an end level below -32 dB and no fragment flagged by tails.py. tails.py passes on all 55 imported files.
Whisper writes numbers as digits (9, 1, 100, 1985); these takes say the numbers in words as written. «Kiellinie» is transcribed as «Key-Linie», which matches the spoken [kiːl]-sound.

Two lines were rewritten after the first generation and recorded in a second small batch: the truck driver no longer asks about Frau Brandt, and Frau Brandt says «unsere Möwe» instead of the ring number HEL 7305, which all three takes read differently.
